Visible example: 4;ab,Z returns ab=3,Z=2.

reference.code:
const f=s=>{const p=s.split(';');if(p.length!==2||!/^[1-9][0-9]*$/.test(p[0])||Number(p[0])>1024||!p[1])return null;const n=Number(p[0]),o=[];for(const k of p[1].split(',')){if(!k||[...k].some(c=>c.charCodeAt(0)<32||c.charCodeAt(0)>126||',;'.includes(c)))return null;o.push(k+'='+([...k].reduce((a,c)=>a+c.charCodeAt(0),0)%n))}return o.join(',')};
exports.shardRouting=f;
